design_notes: Use hairline rules and two rule weights; serif throughout; single accent colour (e.g., deep blue).
Financial tables should use right-aligned numbers and clear column headers.
Industry snapshot: stat strip with three headline numbers, growth bars proportional to value, and a split bar for organised vs unorganised.
Pull quote set in larger serif italic with a left rule.

industry_snapshot.after_paragraph: The company sits in India's specialty chemicals industry.
industry_snapshot.rationale: Industry data includes market size, growth rates, and fragmentation; a snapshot strip makes these scannable.
industry_snapshot.split_bar_note: SMEs hold 70–75% of the market, indicating fragmentation.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: Customer concentration follows: the top ten customers produced about 59% of revenue from operations in FY2015, 57% in FY2016, and 59% in FY2017.
pull_quotes.quote: In FY 2015, FY 2016 and FY 2017, our top 10 customers have accounted for around 59%, 57%, and 59%, respectively, of our revenue from operations.
pull_quotes.rationale: A single damning number that crystallises the customer-concentration risk.

sidebars.body_markdown: The issue is managed by Vivro Financial Services Private Limited, with Link Intime India Private Limited as registrar. [^drhp-p54] [^drhp-p55] The money raised is earmarked for a new manufacturing facility at Plot 336, GIDC Waghodia, Vadodara, Gujarat; general corporate purposes; and creating a public trading market by listing on NSE EMERGE. [^drhp-p75] The total issue size, fresh-issue versus offer-for-sale split, price band, and any selling shareholder are not disclosed in the available excerpts.
sidebars.rationale: Sidebar consolidates the offer's key facts and explicitly flags what is not disclosed, aiding quick reference.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance

tables.after_paragraph: The restated statements cover six periods: the six months to September 30, 2017, and the fiscal years ended March 31, 2017, 2016, 2015, 2014, and 2013.
tables.footnote: Source: DRHP pages 49, 50, 175, 177. Figures converted from ₹ lakh to ₹ crore. Revenue from operations, EBITDA, and debt are not disclosed in the available excerpts.
tables.rationale: The six-period financial history is the core data; a table lets readers compare trends at a glance.
tables.title: Financial summary across six periods

tables.after_paragraph: Pre-issue, the promoters hold 89,48,270 equity shares (99.76% of the pre-issue paid-up equity capital).
tables.rationale: Ownership concentration is a key governance fact; a compact table makes the near-total promoter control immediate.
tables.title: Pre-issue shareholding
